title: Newer Transmitters - xDrip Attempts Auto Restarts, when Disabled & Buggy Calibration experience
body:
I have a 8H transmitter. I used the AAPS instructions for G6 OB1/debug settings, which includes turning off auto restarts.

Yet my last two sensors had xDrip trying to auto restart. Which resulted in a fail, and a bit of a mess to recover from.

Would it be possible to improve this experience... perhaps just have an alert saying a sensor is coming to an end, some time in the morning prior to expiry so one has time do deal with it manually?

Secondly, the calibration experience for newer sensors is very buggy. There are ugly errors in the log and it's quite difficult to get xDrip to actually send the TX a calibration.

comments.body: Seems a reinstall/DB restore may have restotred the auto restart. There is another issue in about calibrating too. Will reopen if needed.
